form.label: AWS Recon: bstoll
form.description: Hunting view for compromised IAM user bstoll's AWS reconnaissance, 2018-08-20.

search.query: index=* sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail eventName=ConsoleLogin additionalEventData.MFAUsed=No userIdentity.type=IAMUser | stats count
index=* sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail userIdentity.userName=bstoll (eventName=GetBucket* OR eventName=ListBucket*) | stats dc(requestParameters.bucketName)
index=* sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail userIdentity.userName=bstoll | timechart span=10m count by eventSource

index=* sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail userIdentity.userName=bstoll | stats count, min(_time) as first, max(_time) as last by sourceIPAddress | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count
index=* sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail userIdentity.userName=bstoll eventName=ConsoleLogin | table _time, sourceIPAddress, additionalEventData.MFAUsed, responseElements.ConsoleLogin | sort _time

index=* sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail userIdentity.userName=bstoll (eventName=GetBucket* OR eventName=ListBucket*) | stats count, values(eventName) as actions by requestParameters.bucketName | sort -count
index=* sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail userIdentity.userName=bstoll (eventName=Describe* OR eventName=List*) | stats count by eventName | sort -count | head 20
